topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Rain's been falling hard all week, but nothing less than a monsoon could wash away this mess. Got a call from Johnny, says his invention—some kind of gadget to help old folks walk straight without tripping over their shadows—turns out it's already patented. Didn’t have the heart to tell him I saw that patent file last month, when I was digging through some cold cases for a different client. Johnny’s voice was all hopeful, like a kid waiting for good news that ain’t coming. Told him I’d look into it, make some calls, maybe there’s a way around this. But I already know there ain’t.
